_comment: In-repo PlatformIO board definition for the M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4).
WHY THIS EXISTS: this project previously used the platform-provided
'esp32-p4-evboard' board, whose Arduino variant
(framework-arduinoespressif32/variants/esp32p4/pins_arduino.h) hardcodes
the generic ESP32-P4-Function-EV-Board's GPIOs for the SDIO link to the
ESP32-C6 radio co-processor (BOARD_SDIO_ESP_HOSTED_* = 18/19/14/15/16/17,
reset 54). Those are NOT the Tab5's pins (12/13/11/10/9/8, reset 15).
cores/esp32/esp32-hal-hosted.c consumes those macros at compile time, so
on real Tab5 hardware esp-hosted drove the wrong pins, the C6 never came
up, and the board crash-looped into the brownout detector. Those macros
have no #ifndef guard, so a -D build flag cannot override them.
This board is a deliberate MINIMAL fork of esp32-p4-evboard.json: every
field below is byte-identical to it except 'variant' (+ the new
'variants_dir'), so every other already-working setting other tasks
depend on (mcu, chip_variant, flash mode/speed, PSRAM, 16MB flash sizing,
upload speed, openocd target) is preserved exactly. The paired variant
boards/variants/quarky_tab5_p4/pins_arduino.h is likewise a minimal fork
of variants/esp32p4/pins_arduino.h with ONLY the seven
BOARD_SDIO_ESP_HOSTED_* pins changed.
Deliberately NOT using the platform's own 'm5stack-tab5-p4' board: it
selects the m5stack_tab5 variant, which (a) drops BOARD_SDMMC_POWER_*,
(b) drops BOARD_PERIMAN_IO_LDO_* (the on-chip LDO VO4 auto-enable that
covers GPIO 39-48 -- i.e. the SD card's slot-0 IOMUX pins 39-44),
(c) moves default SDA/SCL from 7/8 to 53/54, and its companion
m5stack-tab5-p4.py force-installs M5Unified from git into .pio/libdeps.
Each of those is an unrelated behavioural change to already-working
Task 5/6/10 code paths. See hotfix-c6-sdio-pins-report.md.
Build flags are intentionally NOT set here (unlike the platform's
m5stack-tab5-p4.json, which injects USB CDC flags): platformio.ini
already declares -DARDUINO_USB_CDC_ON_BOOT=1 / -DARDUINO_USB_MODE=1 /
-DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM explicitly, and keeping the single source of truth
there avoids duplicate-definition surprises.
name: M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4) -- quarky in-repo board
